speaker: Sheldon
text: Wallowith is trying to outflank us. Let out some string at altitude and I'll go under and cut his line. Focus, Leonard, focus. The heat of battle is upon us. The dogs of war unleashed.

speaker: Leonard
text: Why wouldn't Penny want her friends to meet me? Maybe Kuthra Polly's right. Maybe I embarrass her.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're embarrassing me right now. Grown man worrying about such nonsense, wearing middle flying kites.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sorry.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sorry won't bring their kites down. String burn! String burn!

speaker: Raj
text: Oh, they think we're flanking. They're playing right into our hands. At the count of three, we execute the flying scissor. One, two, three. See what?

speaker: Sheldon
text: You see that? That chick, she smiled at me. Yes, she did. Come on, scissors, scissors. What are you doing? I got scissors by myself. I would come back.

speaker: Raj
text: No, she didn't.

speaker: Raj
text: It's all my life.

speaker: Raj
text: Victory!

speaker: Sheldon
text: Son of a bitch.

speaker: Raj
text: You're a sucky friend, you know that? A sucky, sucky friend. What was I supposed to do? She gave me that come hither look. If she gave you any look at all, it was a you suck look.

speaker: Raj
text: I would have caught up to her if I hadn't pulled a hammy. Oh, please. You weigh 80 pounds. You don't have a hammy.

speaker: Leonard
text: So Penny doesn't want me around her friends. I embarrass her. What else could it be?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, her actions could be out of concern for your feelings. Perhaps she's excluded you from these gatherings because she's scouting for a new mate and doesn't want to do it in front of you.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh. How kind of her.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Agreed. Most primates don't show that sort of discretion. A female bonobo will copulate with a new male in front of the old one without so much as a how do you do.

speaker: Raj
text: I always do this, you know. You ditch me for a woman you don't have a shot with. With a woman you were chasing through a park. That's not a shot. That's a felony. What's worse, it cost me my prized patang fighting kite. Sheldon, I don't suppose there's any chance you could give me my kite back?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I totally had a shot.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm sorry, Raj, but the rules of aerial warfare dictate that the fallen kite go to the victor. And without rules, the competition has no meaning. And without meaning, the following would be an empty gesture. I have your kite.
